About Me

My name is Yulong Liu (刘宇龙), I am interested in the connection of the virtual world and physical reality. The complexity of nature always inspired me to delve deeper and uncover its mysteries. I received my Ph.D. in August 2026, co-supervised by Prof. Yang CHAI at PolyU (HK) and Prof. Terry Tao YE at SUSTech (China). My research topics include e-textile devices, battery-less sensing and in-sensor computing.

You can find my academic track via Google Scholar or ResearchGate. For details of my background, experiences, and full list of publications, please refer to my CV.

关于我

我是刘宇龙，关注虚拟世界与物理现实之间的连接。

我于 2026 年 8 月获得博士学位，由香港理工大学柴扬教授与南方科技大学叶涛教授联合指导。研究方向包括电子织物器件、无电池传感与端侧传感计算。

学术主页见 Google Scholar 或 ResearchGate。背景、经历与完整论文列表请见简历。

最近，我正在参与创建一家基于织物的机器人电子皮肤公司，希望为机器人时代提供触觉数据基础设施。
